h: Adekunle Gold announces $20,000 initiative for sickle cell patients
p: Singer Adekunle Gold has announced a $20,000 initiative to support people living with sickle cell across four countries. He reportedly shared details of the programme on social media, and fans have praised the move.
more: The programme is said to cover patients in four countries.
Details on how to apply have yet to be widely shared.
